hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if [ -n "$f" ] && [ "$(basename -- "$f")" = ".env.local" ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Access to .env.local is blocked by policy."}}'; fi; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) black --quiet "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
